title: WeightUpdateMessage
description: Schema for federated learning client-to-server weight update messages.

client_id.description: Unique identifier for the client sending the update.

model_type.description: Type/architecture of the model being updated (e.g., 'tabular', 'assembly').

weights.description: Model weights represented as numbers or multi-dimensional nested arrays of numbers.

num_samples.description: Number of local training samples used for weighted aggregation.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp when the message was serialized.
